newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Golf-Pampling takes Coolum lead as Grady stumbles.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Golf-Pampling takes Coolum lead as Grady stumbles.

text.p: Australian Rod Pampling took a one shot lead in the Coolum Classic second round on Friday after overnight leader Wayne Grady fell three shots off the pace.
Pampling fired a five-under-par 67 on the Coolum resort course in Queensland for an aggregate of 136 to lead compatriots Greg Chalmers and Stuart Allenby.
Chalmers' 66 was the best round of the day while Allenby, who last week earned a U.S PGA Tour card, shot a 69.
Former U.S. PGA champion Grady stumbled to a 73 after his opening 66.
